requirements.text: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the production ESA: check that the approval mark per paragraph 5.3 is affixed to every unit conforming to the approved type; pass if present.

requirements.text: Markings on ESAs in conformity with paragraph 5.3. above need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking against paragraph 5.3. Pass if the marking meets 5.3. Concealment of the marking when the lamp is installed in the vehicle is acceptable.

requirements.text: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Design review plus the ESA tests of UN R10 (radiated and conducted emissions, radiated and conducted immunity) in normal operating modes (position, stop, reversing). Pass if all R10 limits and immunity criteria are met.

requirements.text: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated emissions.
requirements.test_case: Run the UN R10 ESA radiated emission test with each lamp function powered. Pass if emissions are below the R10 ESA broadband and narrowband limits.

requirements.text: ESA(s) shall be tested for conducted emissions.
requirements.test_case: Run the UN R10 ESA conducted emission (transient) test on the supply lines with each function switched. Pass if transients are within the R10 limits.

requirements.text: ESA(s) shall be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Run the UN R10 ESA radiated immunity test (e.g. absorber chamber, TEM cell, BCI or stripline) at the prescribed field strength with each function on. Pass if there is no unintended flicker, extinction or activation of the position, stop or reversing functions.

requirements.text: ESA(s) shall be tested for immunity to conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Apply the UN R10 ESA conducted transient immunity pulses (ISO 7637-2 test pulses) to the supply lines. Pass if the functional status is met, i.e. no unintended change in lamp function.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission, 30-75 MHz; pass if measured values are below the limit line decreasing logarithmically from 62 to 52 dBµV/m (Appendix 6).

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission, 75-400 MHz; pass if measured values are below the limit line increasing logarithmically from 52 to 63 dBµV/m (Appendix 6).

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission, 400-1,000 MHz; pass if measured values are below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare Annex 7 broadband measurement results across 30-1,000 MHz with the 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if all values are below the limits.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 narrowband radiated emission measurement, 30-75 MHz; pass if emissions are below the limit decreasing logarithmically from 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m (Appendix 7)

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 narrowband radiated emission measurement, 75-400 MHz; pass if emissions are below the limit increasing logarithmically from 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m (Appendix 7)

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 narrowband radiated emission measurement, 400-1,000 MHz; pass if emissions are below 53 dB microvolts/m

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare Annex 8 narrowband measured values across 30-1,000 MHz with the limits of 6.6.2.1 / Appendix 7; pass if all measured values are below the limits

requirements.text: The maximum allowed pulse amplitude of positive polarity for vehicles with 12 V systems shall be +75 V.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 measurement on 12 V supply line, switching the ESA; pass if positive pulse amplitude ≤ +75 V

requirements.text: The maximum allowed pulse amplitude of negative polarity for vehicles with 12 V systems shall be -100 V.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 measurement on 12 V supply line, switching the ESA; pass if negative pulse amplitude does not go below -100 V

requirements.text: The maximum allowed pulse amplitude of positive polarity for vehicles with 24 V systems shall be +150 V.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 measurement on 24 V supply line, switching the ESA; pass if positive pulse amplitude ≤ +150 V

requirements.text: The maximum allowed pulse amplitude of negative polarity for vehicles with 24 V systems shall be -450 V.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 measurement on 24 V supply line, switching the ESA; pass if negative pulse amplitude does not go below -450 V

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a; test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 test using Table 2a levels in >90 % of the 20 to 6,000 MHz band and Table 2b minimum levels over the whole band

requirements.text: Test level in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band (Table 2a): Stripline, 20 to 400 MHz, 60 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 stripline, 20 to 400 MHz at 60 V/m over >90 % of band; no degradation of immunity related functions

requirements.text: Test level in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band (Table 2a): TEM cell, 20 to 200 MHz, 75 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 TEM cell, 20 to 200 MHz at 75 V/m over >90 % of band; no degradation of immunity related functions

requirements.text: Test level in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band (Table 2a): BCI, 20 to 400 MHz, 60 mA.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 bulk current injection, 20 to 400 MHz at 60 mA over >90 % of band; no degradation of immunity related functions

requirements.text: Test level in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band (Table 2a): ALSE, 80 to 2,000 MHz, 30 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 ALSE, 80 to 2,000 MHz at 30 V/m over >90 % of band; no degradation of immunity related functions

requirements.text: Test level in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band (Table 2a): ALSE, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz, 10 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 ALSE, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz at 10 V/m over >90 % of band; no degradation of immunity related functions

requirements.text: Test level in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band (Table 2a): Reverberation chamber, LUF to 2,000 MHz, 21 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber, LUF to 2,000 MHz at 21 V/m over >90 % of band; no degradation of immunity related functions

requirements.text: Test level in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band (Table 2a): Reverberation chamber, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz, 7 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz at 7 V/m over >90 % of band; no degradation of immunity related functions

requirements.text: Minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band (Table 2b): Stripline, 20 to 400 MHz, 50 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 stripline, 20 to 400 MHz, at least 50 V/m at every frequency; no degradation of immunity related functions

requirements.text: Minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band (Table 2b): TEM cell, 20 to 200 MHz, 62,5 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 TEM cell, 20 to 200 MHz, at least 62,5 V/m at every frequency; no degradation of immunity related functions

requirements.text: Minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band (Table 2b): BCI, 20 to 400 MHz, 50 mA.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 BCI, 20 to 400 MHz, at least 50 mA at every frequency; no degradation of immunity related functions

requirements.text: Minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band (Table 2b): ALSE, 80 to 2,000 MHz, 25 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 ALSE, 80 to 2,000 MHz, at least 25 V/m at every frequency; no degradation of immunity related functions

requirements.text: Minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band (Table 2b): ALSE, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz, 8 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 ALSE, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz, at least 8 V/m at every frequency; no degradation of immunity related functions

requirements.text: Minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band (Table 2b): Reverberation chamber, LUF to 2,000 MHz, 18 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber, LUF to 2,000 MHz, at least 18 V/m at every frequency; no degradation of immunity related functions

requirements.text: Minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band (Table 2b): Reverberation chamber, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz, 6 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz, at least 6 V/m at every frequency; no degradation of immunity related functions

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.test_case: During all Annex 9 exposures, monitor rear position, stop and reversing lamp outputs; pass if no flicker, dropout, unintended activation or intensity change (no degradation of immunity related functions)

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 conducted transient test per ISO 16750-2 (starting profile) and ISO 7637-2 (pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b) at Table 3a/3b levels; pass if required functional status/FPSC is met

requirements.text: Starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile per Annex 10; evaluate lamp functions using ISO 16750-1 functional status classification

requirements.text: Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate position, stop and reversing lamp behaviour during/after ISO 7637-2 pulses using ISO 7637-1 FPSC

requirements.text: Starting profile: immunity test level II for 12 V system and II for 24 V system, 10 pulses; functional status B for immunity related functions (for ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases), C for immunity related functions (for other ESA), and D for functions not related to immunity related functions. Starting profile is only applicable to ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor.
requirements.test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile level II, 10 pulses; pass: status B (or C for ESA not operational during engine start) for immunity related functions, D otherwise

requirements.text: Test pulse 1: immunity test level -75 V for 12 V system and -450 V for 24 V system, 500 pulses; FPSC III for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 1 at -75 V (12 V) / -450 V (24 V), 500 pulses; pass: FPSC III

requirements.text: Test pulse 2a: immunity test level +37 V for 12 V system and +37 V for 24 V system, 500 pulses; FPSC I for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 2a at +37 V, 500 pulses; pass: FPSC I for immunity related functions (no lamp flicker/outage), III otherwise

requirements.text: Test pulse 2b: immunity test level +10 V for 12 V system and +20 V for 24 V system, 10 pulses; FPSC II for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 2b at +10 V (12 V) / +20 V (24 V), 10 pulses; pass: FPSC II for immunity related functions, III otherwise

requirements.text: Test pulse 3a: immunity test level -112 V for 12 V system and -150 V for 24 V system, test duration 1 h; FPSC I for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 3a at -112 V (12 V) / -150 V (24 V) for 1 h; pass: FPSC I for immunity related functions, III otherwise

requirements.text: Test pulse 3b: immunity test level +75 V for 12 V system and +150 V for 24 V system, test duration 1 h; FPSC I for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 3b at +75 V (12 V) / +150 V (24 V) for 1 h; pass: FPSC I for immunity related functions, III otherwise

requirements.text: Where an ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, the ESA shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.6.2. and with Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Design review of the circuit diagram and component list for clocks, PWM or switching-regulator oscillators. If no oscillator above 9 kHz is present, the narrowband emission test (paragraph 6.6.2, Annex 8) is waived. Otherwise, test to Annex 8 and meet the paragraph 6.6.2 limits.

requirements.text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
requirements.test_case: Design review of switching elements and inductive loads, such as driver inductors. If the ESA is not switched, contains no switches and has no inductive load, the transient emission test is waived. Otherwise, perform the transient conducted emission test on the supply lines and meet the paragraph 6.7 limits.

requirements.text: ESA broadband reference limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 30-75 MHz band: E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Broadband radiated emission measurement on the ESA per paragraph 6.5.2.1. / 7.10.2.1. (Annex 7 method), 120 kHz bandwidth, 30-75 MHz; pass if the measured level stays at or below 62 - 25.13 log(F/30) dBµV/m at every frequency.

requirements.text: ESA broadband reference limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 75-400 MHz band: E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Broadband radiated emission measurement on the ESA per paragraph 6.5.2.1. / 7.10.2.1. (Annex 7 method), 120 kHz bandwidth, 75-400 MHz; pass if the measured level stays at or below 52 + 15.13 log(F/75) dBµV/m at every frequency.

requirements.text: ESA broadband reference limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 400-1,000 MHz band: E = 63 (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Broadband radiated emission measurement on the ESA per paragraph 6.5.2.1. / 7.10.2.1. (Annex 7 method), 120 kHz bandwidth, 400-1,000 MHz; pass if the measured level stays at or below 63 dBµV/m at every frequency.

requirements.text: The limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 30-75 MHz frequency band shall be E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) (See paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Narrowband ESA radiated emission measurement per paragraph 6.6.2.1. with a 120 kHz bandwidth, 30-75 MHz; pass if every measured level is at or below 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 75-400 MHz frequency band shall be E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) (See paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Narrowband ESA radiated emission measurement per paragraph 6.6.2.1. with a 120 kHz bandwidth, 75-400 MHz; pass if every measured level is at or below 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 400-1,000 MHz frequency band shall be E = 53 (See paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Narrowband ESA radiated emission measurement per paragraph 6.6.2.1. with a 120 kHz bandwidth, 400-1,000 MHz; pass if every measured level is at or below 53 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 test: operate the lamp in normal operation mode, preferably with all LED functions energised (maximum load); verify the operating state is recorded in the test report.

requirements.text: As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) an open area test site (OATS), which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used.
requirements.test_case: If an OATS is used, verify site compliance with CISPR 16-1-4 (Figure 1 of the appendix to Annex 7).

requirements.text: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Measure 30-1,000 MHz in ALSE or OATS; pass if emissions are below the para. 6.5 broadband limits over the whole range.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: During the Annex 8 test, energise the rear position, stop and reversing functions in normal operation, preferably all at maximum load; pass if the operating state is recorded and normal.

requirements.text: As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) an open area test site (OATS) which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used.
requirements.test_case: If an OATS is used, verify its conformity to CISPR 16-1-4 (see Figure 1 of the appendix to Annex 7).

requirements.text: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Scan from 30 to 1,000 MHz in the ALSE or OATS; pass if the emissions stay below the paragraph 6.6.2.1 narrowband limits across the whole range.

requirements.text: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the receiver detector is set to average for all scans.

requirements.text: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered: (a) Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2; (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3; (c) Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4; (d) Stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5; (e) Reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Review the test plan: the chosen combination of ISO 11452-2/-3/-4/-5/-11 methods must jointly cover 20 to 6,000 MHz without gaps.

requirements.text: Frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report: frequency range and general conditions are taken from ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The test conditions shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report: temperature, supply voltage and other conditions follow ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on.
requirements.test_case: During exposure, verify the lamp is powered (position, stop and reversing functions energised).

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Check that each lamp function is operated in its normal mode during the test and monitored for malfunction.

requirements.text: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the sweep from 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 step sizes; the lamp functions must show no prohibited degradation.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Verify the signal generator settings in 20–400 MHz: AM, 1 kHz, 80 % depth.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Verify the generator settings in 2,700–3,100 MHz: pulse modulation, Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.test_case: Verify the generator settings in 380–2,700 MHz and 3,100–6,000 MHz: pulse modulation, Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs.

requirements.text: Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the step size and dwell time in the test report against ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: As an alternative the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: For in-vehicle testing, verify ISO 11451-4 with the substitution method and the probe at 150 mm from the lamp.

requirements.text: Apply the test pulse 1 according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 1 at the 12/24 V supply and connected lines; rear lamp functions meet the immunity performance criteria.

requirements.text: Apply the test pulse 2a according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 2a at the 12/24 V supply and connected lines; rear lamp functions meet the immunity performance criteria.

requirements.text: Apply the test pulse 2b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 2b at the 12/24 V supply and connected lines; rear lamp functions meet the immunity performance criteria.

requirements.text: Apply the test pulse 3a according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 3a at the 12/24 V supply and connected lines; rear lamp functions meet the immunity performance criteria.

requirements.text: Apply the test pulse 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 3b at the 12/24 V supply and connected lines; rear lamp functions meet the immunity performance criteria.

requirements.text: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile on the 12/24 V supply and connected lines; rear lamp functions meet the immunity performance criteria.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Drawing and sample inspection: a marking area is present that accommodates the full approval marking, trade name and voltage marking; pass if all required markings fit legibly.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection plus durability check (e.g. rubbing with water/petroleum-spirit-soaked cloth); pass if markings remain clearly legible and undamaged.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure dimension "a" of the approval mark on drawing and sample (per Annex 7 arrangement); pass if a >= 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of marking against approval documents; pass if circled "E" with correct country number is present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection; pass if a 4- to 6-digit sequential number matching the approval number is present.

requirements.text: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of marking layout versus Annex 7 examples; pass if sequential number is adjacent to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection; pass if the function symbols per paragraph 3.2.4 for all approved functions are present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection; pass if "148R" followed by the correct two-digit series of amendments is present.

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall consist of a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of left- and right-hand units; pass if each bears a horizontal arrow indicating mounting position.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of lamp as mounted on vehicle; pass if arrow points outward from the vehicle.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
requirements.test_case: If reversing lamp has reduced light distribution, inspect arrow on mounted lamp; pass if arrow points outward from the vehicle.

requirements.text: If applicable, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4., the additional letter "D" shall be placed on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
requirements.test_case: If lamp approved as part of an assembly of two independent lamps, visual inspection; pass if "D" is right of the relevant function symbol.

requirements.text: If applicable, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4., the additional letter "Y" shall be placed on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.
requirements.test_case: If lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, visual inspection; pass if "Y" is right of the relevant function symbol.

requirements.text: On lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, the approval marking shall consist of a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
requirements.test_case: If any function has reduced light distribution per Annex 3 para 1.1, visual inspection; pass if downward vertical arrow from horizontal segment is present.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of production sample; pass if complete approval marking is present.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection; pass if applicant's trade name or mark is present.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with non-replaceable light sources.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection; pass if rated voltage (e.g. 12V) or voltage range is marked on the lamp.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear.
requirements.test_case: If electronic light source control gear is used, visual inspection; pass if rated voltage or range is marked.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Drawing and sample inspection; pass if marking is on a part not designed to be separated from the light-emitting outer lens.

requirements.text: In any case the approval marking shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp installed on M1 vehicle (with boot lid/doors opened if needed); pass if approval marking is visible.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: If outer lens is detachable, inspect both lens and housing; pass if approval marking is on both.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect main body of each device; pass if each bears only the approval marking of its own function(s).

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection; pass if approval marking is on the lamp itself.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraph 3.3.3.2. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection; pass if trade name/mark is on the lamp.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraph 3.3.3.4. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection; pass if voltage marking is on the lamp.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number may be affixed, located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that it is visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: If single approval mark is used, inspect lamp installed on vehicle; pass if mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number may be affixed, located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: If single approval mark is used, design review/disassembly check; pass if no light-transmitting part is removable without removing the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure mark components; pass if each is not smaller than the minimum size of the smallest individual mark required by the applicable UN Regulations.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Verify conformity of each lamp function (rear position, stop, reversing) to all requirements of UN R148 paragraphs 4. and 5. by review of the test report against each sub-paragraph; pass if every applicable requirement in paragraphs 4. and 5. is met.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Document review against UN R48 sections 5 and 6 and referenced Annexes, using the series of amendments in force at the date of application. Pass if each applicable general and individual specification is verified as met.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Build a compliance matrix of the UN R48 requirements for each function on M1 vehicles, such as geometric visibility, colour and number. Check each item that can be verified at lamp type approval on the lamp or its drawings. Pass if all feasible items are verified compliant.

requirements.text: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Design review and vibration/durability test of the complete lamp in vehicle-representative mounting (e.g. manufacturer vibration profile for body-mounted rear lamps); after exposure verify all functions operate, no loosening/cracking/water ingress, and photometric intensities and colour still meet R148 limits.

requirements.text: An assembly of two independent lamps to be type approved as lamp marked "D" is applicable to rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Documentation and marking review: confirm that the "D" marking is used only if the rear position lamp function is an assembly of two independent lamps. Pass if the "D" marking appears only on an eligible function.

requirements.text: An assembly of two independent lamps to be type approved as lamp marked "D" is applicable to stop lamps.
requirements.test_case: Documentation and marking review: confirm that the "D" marking is used only if the stop lamp function is an assembly of two independent lamps. Pass if the "D" marking appears only on an eligible function.

requirements.text: An interdependent lamp system to be type approved as lamps marked "Y" is applicable to rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Documentation and marking review: confirm that the "Y" marking is used only if the rear position lamp function is an interdependent lamp system. Pass if the "Y" marking appears only on an eligible function.

requirements.text: An interdependent lamp system to be type approved as lamps marked "Y" is applicable to stop lamps.
requirements.test_case: Documentation and marking review: confirm that the "Y" marking is used only if the stop lamp function is an interdependent lamp system. Pass if the "Y" marking appears only on an eligible function.

requirements.text: Position lamps which are reciprocally incorporated with another function, using a common light source, and designed to operate permanently with an additional system to regulate the intensity of the light emitted, are permitted.
requirements.test_case: Design review of the circuit and light sources: if the rear position and stop functions share a common light source, confirm a permanently operating intensity-regulation system is fitted; then check photometry of both functions per R148.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source) or be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the LED/PCB layout and the documentation. Pass if the two functions use multiple light sources, or if the lamp is declared for use with a vehicle failure tell-tale.

requirements.text: The internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: pass if at most one logo is present. Then run the full photometric and colorimetric tests for the function carrying the logo; all must be met.

requirements.text: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the logo and the applicant statement. Pass if the logo is only the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer.

requirements.text: The enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the enclosed logo light-emitting surface projected in the direction of the reference axis. Pass if it is ≤ 100 cm2.

requirements.text: Stop lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the stop lamp's apparent surface, optics and outer lens. Pass if no logo is present.

requirements.text: Reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the reversing lamp's apparent surface, optics and outer lens window. Pass if no logo is present.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review the circuit diagram and inspect the PCB wiring. Open-circuit one LED in each group and verify whether all LEDs of that group stop emitting. Pass: each group that fully extinguishes is treated as one light source in the failure assessment.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) The light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) A signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced.
requirements.test_case: For each function, simulate failure of each light source (or group) in turn and measure photometry at the Annex 3 standard light distribution points. Pass for option (a): all points meet the minimum values, and with all sources lit no maximum is exceeded. Pass for option (b): a failure signal for the tell-tale is produced on every single-source failure, and the communication form notes that the lamp is for use only on vehicles fitted with a failure tell-tale.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control (open or short the control input) while the lamp is in a state above the R1 maximum. Measure luminous intensity. Pass: the lamp automatically reverts to steady luminous intensity within the category requirements.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control while the lamp is in a state above the S1 maximum. Measure luminous intensity. Pass: the lamp automatically reverts to steady luminous intensity within the category requirements.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control while the lamp is in a state above the S3 maximum. Measure luminous intensity. Pass: the lamp automatically reverts to steady luminous intensity within the category requirements.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with: replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Design review of light source types fitted to each function; pass if only UN R37/R99/R128-approved replaceable sources, light source modules or non-replaceable sources are used

requirements.text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: EMC testing of radiated and conducted (power line) emissions at vehicle level / per vehicle EMC requirements (e.g. UN R10); pass if no malfunction of other vehicle electric/electronic systems

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
requirements.test_case: Fitment check in all orientations and positions; pass if module fits only in designated correct position

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Attempt removal by hand without tools; pass if removal is impossible without tool(s)

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of module construction for tamper resistance (sealed, no accessible internals); pass if module cannot be opened or altered without destruction

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit UN approved replaceable light sources in module holder and vice versa, with tools; pass if not interchangeable

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module is not interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to swap modules of different functions/characteristics within the housing, with tools; pass if not interchangeable

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace module with another of same identification code supplied by applicant and repeat photometric measurements; pass if all photometric requirements are met

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.test_case: Confirm each function is measured in steady continuous operation, with no flashing or PWM start-up transient. Pass if readings are taken in continuous lit state.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Measure the voltage at the lamp connector during the test. Pass if it is 13.5 V for a 12 V system, or the value applicable to the declared system.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lamp through the applicant-specified control gear and supply conditions. Pass if the test conditions match the applicant's specification.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lamp at the applicant-specified supply conditions. Pass if the test conditions match the specification.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Annex 3/Annex 8 goniophotometry of both samples at HV. Pass if intensity is at least the paragraph 5 minimum for each function.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall in no direction where the lamp is visible exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Scan the full visible field of both samples. Pass if no value exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure each grid point of the Annex 3 light distribution figure. Pass if each value is at least the paragraph 5 minimum multiplied by the grid percentage.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure each grid point where Annex 3 gives absolute values. Pass if each value is at least the specified intensity.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure across the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles for each function. Pass if all values are at least the paragraph 5 minimum.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Visually examine the beam and check local variations against Annex 3. Pass if no intensity between two grid directions falls below the Annex 3 local-variation criterion.

requirements.text: In order to verify the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No.48, the applicant may request an additional test, to show that in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction, the maximum intensity is not more than 2.5∙10-1cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometry over 165° to 180° outboard H and -2.5° to +5° V, optionally with vehicle body influence. Pass if the maximum is at most 0.25 cd.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.test_case: Measure the rear position lamp alone, then position and stop lamps together, at all grid points within ±5° V and ±10° H. Pass if the combined-to-alone ratio is at least 5:1 at each point.

requirements.text: If one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered are those obtained with all sources in operation.
requirements.test_case: Perform the ratio measurement with all LEDs of each function energised. Pass if the 5:1 ratio is met.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3 no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Visual/colorimetric inspection outside the Annex 3 grid field for each function; pass if no sharp colour variation is observed.

requirements.text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Measure colour with the LED light sources installed in the lamp, per relevant subparagraphs of 4.8; pass if chromaticity within limits.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1 and Table 4; pass if all Table 4 values are met

requirements.text: The minimum luminous intensity of rear position lamps of category R1 (steady) shall be 4∙10^0 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement on reference axis per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(a); pass if ≥ 4 cd

requirements.text: The maximum luminous intensity of rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), when used as a single lamp, shall be 1.7∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer scan of the full light distribution per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(b); pass if ≤ 17 cd in all directions (≤ 60 cd below 5° down if reciprocally incorporated with stop lamp)

requirements.text: The maximum luminous intensity of rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), shall be 8.5∙10^0 cd.
requirements.test_case: Only if the lamp is marked "D": goniophotometer scan per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(b); pass if ≤ 8.5 cd

requirements.text: The minimum luminous intensity of rear position lamps of category R2 (variable) shall be 4∙10^0 cd.
requirements.test_case: Only if the lamp is category R2: goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(a); pass if ≥ 4 cd

requirements.text: The maximum luminous intensity of rear position lamps of category R2 (variable), when used as a single lamp, shall be 4.2∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Only if the lamp is category R2: goniophotometer scan per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(b); pass if ≤ 42 cd

requirements.text: The maximum luminous intensity of rear position lamps of category R2 (variable), when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), shall be 2.1∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Only if the lamp is category R2 and marked "D": goniophotometer scan per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(b); pass if ≤ 21 cd

requirements.text: The standard light distribution of rear position lamps shall be as defined in Figure A3-I and Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure grid points of Figure A3-I and compare with Table A2-1 percentages per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(c); pass if each point meets its requirement

requirements.text: The minimum luminous intensity of rear position lamps within the angles of geometric visibility (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)) shall be 5∙10^-2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Measure across the geometric visibility angles per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(d); pass if ≥ 0.05 cd in all directions

requirements.text: A luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer scan below 5° down from horizontal; pass if ≤ 60 cd in that region (Table 4 maximum elsewhere)

requirements.text: Failure provisions for rear position lamps shall be as specified in paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Simulate light source failure per paragraph 4.6; pass if paragraph 4.6 criteria are met

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by rear position lamps shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light; pass if chromaticity is within the red boundaries

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7: for a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)) shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 3 on both samples; intensity at the reference axis/test points ≥ 60 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7: for a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) when used as a single lamp shall be 2.60∙10^2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement on both samples; no direction exceeds 260 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7: for a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) shall be 1.30∙10^2 cd.
requirements.test_case: If marked "D": goniophotometric measurement on both samples; no direction exceeds 130 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7: for a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the angles of geometric visibility (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)) shall be as defined in Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Verify geometric visibility angles against Figure A3-I.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7: for a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) shall be as defined in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure at test points of Table A2-1; values meet the prescribed percentages of minimum intensity.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7: for a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility shall be 3∙10^-1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Measure throughout the Figure A3-I field; intensity ≥ 0.3 cd everywhere.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7: for a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)) shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement on both samples; intensity ≥ 60 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7: for a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) when used as a single lamp shall be 7.30∙10^2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement on both samples; no direction exceeds 730 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7: for a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) shall be 3.65∙10^2 cd.
requirements.test_case: If marked "D": goniophotometric measurement; no direction exceeds 365 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7: for a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the angles of geometric visibility (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)) shall be as defined in Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Verify geometric visibility angles against Figure A3-I.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7: for a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) shall be as defined in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure at test points of Table A2-1; values meet prescribed percentages.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7: for a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility shall be 3∙10^-1 cd (day).
requirements.test_case: Day condition: measure throughout Figure A3-I field; intensity ≥ 0.3 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7: for a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility shall be 7∙10^-2 cd (night).
requirements.test_case: Night condition: measure throughout Figure A3-I field; intensity ≥ 0.07 cd.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement per regulation colour definitions; chromaticity within red boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10: the minimum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)) for reversing lamps of category AR shall be 8.0∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of both samples per para 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if intensity ≥ 80 cd where minimum applies.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10: the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) for reversing lamps of category AR in or above the H-plane shall be 3.00∙10^2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer scan of both samples in and above the H-plane; pass if no value exceeds 300 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10: the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) for reversing lamps of category AR below the H-plane, down to 5°D, shall be 6.00∙10^2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer scan of both samples from H-plane down to 5°D; pass if no value exceeds 600 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10: the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) for reversing lamps of category AR below 5°D shall be 8.00∙10^3 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer scan of both samples below 5°D; pass if no value exceeds 8000 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10: the standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) for reversing lamps of category AR shall be as defined in Figure A3-V.
requirements.test_case: Measure both samples at the grid points of Figure A3-V; pass if each point meets the specified percentage of the minimum intensity.

requirements.text: In the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.test_case: If pair-only approval claimed: goniophotometer measurement up to 30° inwards; pass if intensity ≥ 25 cd at 30° inwards.

requirements.text: In the case where the type approval is granted applying the pair condition, the device shall only be installed in a pair.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the pair-only approved reversing lamp is fitted as a left/right pair.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the white boundaries defined in the regulation.

requirements.text: No measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of production samples at the prescribed test points per Annexes 4/5; pass if no value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 % from the prescribed min/max values.

requirements.text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3 the measured values shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12.
requirements.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity at the field points of Annexes 2 and 3 on production samples; pass if each measured value is at least the Table 12 equivalent 20 per cent value (or 30 per cent value where applicable), e.g. 7∙10-1 cd required -> 5∙10-1 cd (20 %) / 3∙10-1 cd (30 %).

requirements.text: Front/rear position (A, R1, R2): minimum horizontal angles (inboard / outboard) 45°/80°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check of the apparent surface on a goniometer with the lamp in its mounting orientation. Pass if the apparent surface is visible over at least 45° inboard and 80° outboard.

requirements.text: Front/rear position (A, R1, R2): minimum horizontal angles (inboard / outboard) (20°/80°), reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm.
requirements.test_case: If the H-plane mounting height is below 750 mm, verify visibility below the H-plane over at least 20° inboard and 80° outboard. Pass if the apparent surface is visible over these angles.

requirements.text: Front/rear position (A, R1, R2): minimum vertical angles (above / below) 15°/15°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check in the vertical plane. Pass if the apparent surface is visible from 15° above to 15° below the H-plane.

requirements.text: Front/rear position (A, R1, R2): minimum vertical angles (above / below) (15°/5°) for lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm.
requirements.test_case: If the mounting height is below 750 mm, verify vertical visibility. Pass if the apparent surface is visible from 15° above to 5° below the H-plane.

requirements.text: Stop lamp (S1, S2): minimum horizontal angles (inboard / outboard) 45°/45°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check of the stop lamp apparent surface on a goniometer. Pass if the apparent surface is visible over at least 45° inboard and 45° outboard.

requirements.text: Stop lamp (S1, S2): minimum horizontal angles (inboard / outboard) (20°/45°), reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm.
requirements.test_case: If the H-plane is below 750 mm, verify visibility below the H-plane. Pass if the apparent surface is visible over at least 20° inboard and 45° outboard.

requirements.text: Stop lamp (S1, S2): minimum vertical angles (above / below) 15°/15°.
requirements.test_case: Vertical geometric visibility check. Pass if the apparent surface is visible from 15° above to 15° below the H-plane.

requirements.text: Stop lamp (S1, S2): minimum vertical angles (above / below) (15°/5°) for lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm.
requirements.test_case: If the mounting height is below 750 mm, verify vertical visibility. Pass if the apparent surface is visible from 15° above to 5° below the H-plane.

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement at the Annex 3 grid points; compute the % of the required minimum, rounded down to 3 significant digits; each point must meet or exceed the value.

requirements.text: In the case where rear position lamps are intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the manufacturer's H-plane mounting height. If ≤ 750 mm, limit downward photometric verification to V = -5°.

requirements.text: In the case where stop lamps of category S1, S2 and MS are intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the manufacturer's H-plane mounting height. If ≤ 750 mm, limit downward photometric verification of the S1/S2 stop lamp to V = -5°.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric scan between grid points. The intensity in each grid cell must be at least the lowest surrounding grid minimum (%).

requirements.text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: Visual examination of the reversing lamp; if local variations are seen, measure between adjacent Figure A3-V points. The intensity must be ≥ 50 % of the lower of the two prescribed minima.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps, the values shown in Figure A3-I give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8).
requirements.test_case: Photometry at the Figure A3-I points. The intensity must be ≥ the stated % of the required minimum.

requirements.text: For stop lamps (S1, S2 and MS), the values shown in Figure A3-I give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8).
requirements.test_case: Photometry at the Figure A3-I points. The intensity must be ≥ the stated % of the Table 7 minimum.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps, the values shown in figure A3-V give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities in cd.
requirements.test_case: Photometry at the Figure A3-V points relative to the axis of reference. The intensity must be ≥ the cd value shown.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement under conditions of paragraph 4.9 of UN R148; pass if chromaticity coordinates are within the prescribed colour limits

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: CoP colorimetric measurement under the conditions of paragraph 4.9. of UN R148; pass if chromaticity coordinates are within the prescribed colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The following approval marking arrangements are given merely as examples and any other arrangement made in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation is acceptable.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval marking on the lamp against paragraph 3.3. of UN R148 (Annex 7 examples for reference); pass if the arrangement complies with paragraph 3.3.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.1: operate the reversing function and measure luminous intensity distribution after 1 min and 10 min of operation, or calculate it from the distribution after photometric stability using the HV ratios. Pass if all test points are at or above the minimum values.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.1 after 1 min and 10 min of operation, measured directly or calculated using the HV ratios. Pass if no test point exceeds the maximum values.

requirements.text: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation, or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.2: measure the rear position and stop functions after 1 min and after either 30 min of operation or photometric stability. The 1 min distribution may be calculated using the HV ratio. Pass if all test points meet the minimum values.

requirements.text: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation, or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.2 after 1 min and after either 30 min of operation or photometric stability. Pass if no test point exceeds the maximum values, including the stop and position lamp maximums.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect drawings and samples: a marking space is present and large enough for the UI or approval marking plus the paragraph 3.3.4.2 markings at the Table 1 size.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual check that the markings are legible. Rub with a cloth soaked in water and then in petrol; the markings must remain legible.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” is defined in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval mark dimensions; the size of “a” must be at least the Table 1 value.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: a circle surrounding "E" and the distinguishing country number are present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: a 4–6 digit sequential number matching the approval number is present.

requirements.text: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: the sequential number is adjacent to the E-circle, as in the Annex 10 examples.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: the class symbol per paragraph 3.2.5 (e.g. IA) is present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: the marking contains "150R" followed by the correct two-digit series number.

requirements.text: The approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. may be replaced by the Unique Identifier, if available. The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown below: Figure I Unique Identifier (UI).
requirements.test_case: If a UI is used, compare it with the Figure I format; the layout must match.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: the applicant's trade name or mark is present on the device.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear, in case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Review the manufacturer's rotation specification. If orientation is not unambiguous, "TOP" must be inscribed horizontally at the highest part of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the device: the approval marking/UI, trade name and any TOP marking are clearly legible.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier may be affixed. This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that it is visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Install the lamp on the vehicle or a representative fixture; the single mark must be visible.

requirements.text: This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.test_case: Design review and disassembly check: no light-transmitting part (outer lens, reversing window, retro-reflector) can be removed without also removing the mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mark components; each must be at least the smallest minimum size required by the applicable UN Regulations.

requirements.text: Retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Test production samples of the retro-reflector against the requirements of paragraphs 4. and 5. (photometric, colorimetric and other specifications); pass if the samples meet them and conform to the approved type.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
