requirements.test_case: Document review: confirm that the retro-reflector satisfies UN R48 sections 5 and 6 and the Annexes they reference, in the series of amendments in force at the time of application. Pass if every applicable item verifiable at component level is met.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Review the UN R48 requirements for rear retro-reflectors on M1 vehicles, such as geometric visibility angles and orientation. Verify those that can be checked at device approval, using drawings and goniometric or visual inspection of the mounting reference. Pass if all feasible pertinent requirements are met.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Design review and type approval testing of the retro-reflector to UN R150 (photometric, colorimetric and resistance tests); pass if the device meets all requirements before and after the tests.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of design drawings and production samples; pass if no defect affecting efficient operation or maintenance in good condition is found.

requirements.text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.test_case: Manual dismantling attempt on samples without tools; pass if the retro-reflector components cannot be easily separated.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
requirements.test_case: Visual and tactile inspection of the outer surface; pass if the surface can be readily cleaned.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not be rough.
requirements.test_case: Visual and tactile inspection of the outer surface; pass if the surface is smooth.

requirements.text: Any protuberances the outer surface of retro-reflective devices may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of any protuberances on the outer surface; pass if they do not hinder cleaning.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the assembled lamp in vehicle-mounted condition; pass if the inner surface of the retro-reflector is not accessible.

requirements.text: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: Design review and separation attempt under normal conditions of use; pass if the optical unit and filter cannot be separated.

requirements.text: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
requirements.test_case: Material specification review and inspection; pass if colour is obtained without paint or varnish.

requirements.text: The colouring of filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
requirements.test_case: Material specification review and inspection; pass if filter colour is obtained without paint or varnish.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric test per para. 4.2.1.2: confirm the set-up uses CIE Standard Illuminant A, divergence angle 1/3° and β1 = β2 = 0°, or the Annex 4, Part 1, para. 1.1 angle if 0° gives a colourless surface reflection. Pass if the set-up conforms.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Illuminate with CIE Illuminant A at divergence 1/3° and β1 = β2 = 0° (or the Annex 4 Part 1 para 1.1 angle). Measure the chromaticity x,y of the reflected light. Pass if x,y lie within the UN R48 night-time red retro-reflected colour limits.

requirements.text: For testing the daytime colour, the material shall be illuminated by the CIE Standard Illuminant D65 (ISO 11664- 2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) using geometry (45a:0) or (0:45a) as described in Part 2 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Daytime colour test per Annex 4 Part 2: illuminate the material with CIE D65 using (45a:0) or (0:45a) geometry and measure the chromaticity. Pass if the set-up conforms and the measured colour lies within the specified daytime colour limits.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of shape and dimensions per Annex 5 on all ten samples (Table 4). Pass: conforms to Annex 5.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 and colorimetry per paragraph 4.2. in the Table 4 sequence. Pass: RI and colour within paragraphs 5.1.4. and 5.1.5.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.test_case: Run the Table 4 sequence: heat, water, fuels/oils, corrosion, rear face, stability in time, weathering. Pass: no distortion or damage, and photometry and colorimetry still compliant.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetry per paragraph 4.2. after each test group, using trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt. Pass: red night-time colour limits of UN R48.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 after each test group. Pass: RI meets the Table 3 minima.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA, IB must be equal to or greater than 3.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 for an angle of divergence of 20' at illumination angles β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4 at α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0°. Pass: RI of at least 300 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA, IB must be equal to or greater than 2.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 for an angle of divergence of 20' at illumination angles β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 at α = 20', β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°. Pass: RI of at least 200 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA, IB must be equal to or greater than 1.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 for an angle of divergence of 20' at illumination angles β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 at α = 20', β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°. Pass: RI of at least 100 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA, IB must be equal to or greater than 5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 for an angle of divergence of 1°30' at illumination angles β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 at α = 1°30', β1 = β2 = 0°. Pass: RI of at least 5 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA, IB must be equal to or greater than 2.8∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 for an angle of divergence of 1°30' at illumination angles β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 at α = 1°30', β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°. Pass: RI of at least 2.8 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA, IB must be equal to or greater than 2.5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 for an angle of divergence of 1°30' at illumination angles β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 at α = 1°30', β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°. Pass: RI of at least 2.5 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.test_case: Photometric scan within the bounded solid angle. Pass: no RI value below the applicable Table 3 values.

requirements.text: In the case where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the declared mounting height. If the H plane is below 750 mm, verify RI downward only to 5°. Pass: Table 3 minima met within the applicable range.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux must be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Trichromatic coordinate measurement of the reflected light. Pass: coordinates within the UN R48 red night-time colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of production samples per R150; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the prescribed red boundaries.

requirements.text: In any test of conformity carried out by the manufacturer, equivalent methods may be used with the consent of the Type Approval Authority.
requirements.test_case: If alternative methods are used, verify Type Approval Authority consent and manufacturer's proof of equivalence.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of production retro-reflector samples; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the prescribed red colour limits of R150.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Annex 4 Part 1 para 1.2: β1 = β2 = 0°, α = 20', rotate about the reference axis to minimum RI; pass if minimum RI ≥ the para 5 value.

requirements.text: If the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from that position.
requirements.test_case: Annex 4 Part 1 para 1.2: if values are not met, rotate ±5° from the minimum-RI position; pass if specified values are attained within that range.

requirements.text: The RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
requirements.test_case: Annex 4 Part 1 para 1.3: record RI continuously during the ±5° rotation; pass if RI ≥ the prescribed value at every position.

requirements.text: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Annex 4 Part 1 para 3.3: verify source calibrated to CIE Standard Illuminant A and the procedure of Annex 4 Part 1 is followed.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the retro-reflector illuminating surface, as fitted behind the outer lens, from an observation distance of 10 m. Pass: the shape is not easily confused with the equilateral triangular shape of Class IIIA/IIIB retro-reflectors (Annex 5, paragraph 2.1).

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 1 para. 1 heat resistance: condition sample in dry atmosphere at 65 °C ± 2 °C for 48 consecutive hours; verify chamber temperature log and duration.

requirements.text: After this test, no cracking of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection after Annex 6 Part 1 heat test and cooling: pass if no cracks visible on retro-reflector body or optical component.

requirements.text: After this test, no appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visual/dimensional inspection after Annex 6 Part 1 heat test and cooling: pass if no appreciable distortion visible on retro-reflector body or optical component.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not shall be immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para 1.1: immerse for 10 min in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C with the highest point of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the water surface; then assess per para 1.2.

requirements.text: The immersion test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para 1.1: repeat the 10 min / 50 °C ± 5 °C immersion inverted, illuminating surface down, rear face under about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para 1.1: immediately after the 50 °C immersions, immerse under the same conditions in water at 25 °C ± 5 °C; then assess per paras 1.2 and 1.3.

requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para 1.2: after the immersion sequence, visually inspect the reflecting surface; pass if no water is present.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para 1.2: visual inspection after immersion; fail if water is clearly visible at the reflecting surface.

requirements.text: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the following tests (moisture and dust test) shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3: apply the moisture test (para. 2) and the dust exposure test (para. 2.3) on manufacturer request; pass if both evaluations are met.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Water spray test para. 2.2.3: operate the lamp functions at design voltage, 5 min ON / 55 min OFF; pass if the cycle is applied throughout.

requirements.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.test_case: Water spray test para. 2.2.4: verify the duration; pass if 12 h, 12 cycles.

requirements.text: No standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Water spray test para. 2.2.6: inspect, tap and tilt the device; pass if no standing pool of water is present or formed.

requirements.text: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours.
requirements.test_case: Dust test para. 2.3.6: verify an agitation of 2–15 s every 15 min over 5 h; pass if the schedule is met.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Corrosion test per Annex 6 Part 4 / ISO 9227:2017; after test, photometric (RA) and colorimetric characteristics still within prescribed limits.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Remove all removable parts; salt mist exposure 24 h + 2 h drying + 24 h (50 h total); verify test sequence recorded.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Verify salt mist chamber at 35 °C ± 2 °C with 5 % NaCl in distilled water with ≤ 0.02 % impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection immediately after 50 h salt mist test; pass if no excessive corrosion impairing efficiency.

requirements.text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≥ Table 9 value.

requirements.text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not more than the value in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≤ Table 10 value.

requirements.text: The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1, in case of retro-reflective devices for a period of 500 hours.
requirements.test_case: Expose the retro-reflector samples per EN ISO 4892-2:2013 for 500 h using TM1 cycle 1 or TM2 cycle 4: 102 min dry / 18 min water spray; 60 ± 2 W/m² (300-400 nm) or 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² at 340 nm; 65 ± 3 °C BST or 63 ± 3 °C BPT; 50 ± 10 % RH. Pass if the full exposure is completed with the parameters in tolerance.

requirements.text: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for a retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1: Confirm the test mixture is 70 vol.% n-heptane and 30 vol.% toluol before testing the retro-reflector. Pass if the mixture composition matches.

requirements.text: The surface of the retro-reflective device must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1 para 1.1(b): After the fuel wipe and a wait of about 5 minutes, visually inspect the surface. Pass if there are no apparent surface changes; slight surface cracks are acceptable.

requirements.text: The approval number must be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval mark on the retro-reflective device against Annex 10 Figure A10-I: the approval number is located adjacent to the circle surrounding "E".

requirements.text: The digits constituting the approval number must face the same way as the "E".
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval mark: the approval number digits have the same orientation as the letter "E".

requirements.text: The group of symbols indicating the class must be diametrically opposite the approval number.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval mark: the class symbol (e.g. IA) is positioned diametrically opposite the approval number relative to the circle.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, the lighting and light-signalling devices retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the installed lamp on the M1 vehicle under normal conditions of use (paras 2.3.10.–2.3.10.2.) and after vibration exposure; pass if photometric, colour and geometric characteristics remain within R48/component regulation limits.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, the lighting and light-signalling devices enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation check per R48 (position, geometric visibility, orientation, electrical connections) under normal conditions of use and after vibration; pass if all R48 installation requirements remain met.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of mounting design: verify lamp is fixed by positive locating features/fasteners with no accessible free adjustment; pass if lamp orientation cannot change through normal handling, servicing or vibration.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reference axis of each installed function relative to the vehicle's bearing plane on the road; pass if parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of all other signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reference axis of each installed function relative to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane; pass if parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.
requirements.test_case: Measure the angular deviation of the reference axis in the vertical and horizontal directions; pass if each deviation is within ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp against the manufacturer's fitting instructions; pass if all instructions are met.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle drawings and the installed vehicle, and measure the lateral positions of the exterior geometrical form of the LH and RH housings/outer lenses relative to the median longitudinal plane. Pass if they are symmetrical.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the LH and RH unit drawings/CAD and the physical samples, mirrored about the median longitudinal plane, ignoring interior structure. Pass if the exterior shapes are mirror-symmetrical.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Perform colorimetric measurement of each function on the LH and RH samples according to the device regulation (e.g. UN R148/R150 or R7/R23/R3). Pass if both sides meet the same colour requirement (red for position/stop/retro-reflector, white for reversing).

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Perform goniophotometric measurement of each function on the LH and RH units, using the mirrored measurement grid. Pass if intensity distributions are substantially identical and each side meets its own minimum/maximum values, unless the function is approved as a matched pair.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle rear lamp layout. Pass if logos in rear lamps are limited to one per side (two lateral) or one central logo.

requirements.text: All logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the lamp and drawings. Pass if any logo present is only a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical the above requirements shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection per UN R48 on an M1 vehicle with asymmetrical external shape: check that the preceding installation requirements (e.g. symmetrical pairing, position, geometric visibility) are met as far as the body shape allows, and that any deviation is justified by the asymmetry.

requirements.text: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Installation and design review on the M1 vehicle against R48 paras 5 and 6 for each function: verify colour, mounting position, orientation, geometric visibility angles and electrical connections. Pass if every function meets its individual requirements while grouped.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Photometric goniometer and colorimeter measurement of each function with all other functions of the unit switched OFF, per the applicable device regulation (R7, R23, R3 or R148/R150). Pass if intensity and chromaticity limits are met for each function.

requirements.text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the stop lamp (red) with the rear position lamp and stop lamp switched ON simultaneously. Pass if the chromaticity coordinates are within the red colour boundaries of R48 para 5.11 / R148.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Project the distinct parts of the apparent surface along the reference axis onto a plane tangent to the outer lens (CAD/drawing measurement). Pass if projected area >= 60 % of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or the gap between facing edges of adjacent parts <= 75 mm measured perpendicular to the reference axis.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Operate each function at its nominal supply in steady state. Monitor luminous intensity, chromaticity and apparent surface over the switched-ON period. Pass if no intentional variation (no dimming patterns, flicker modes or segment changes) occurs unless specifically permitted.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: If ambient-light-dependent variation is implemented, measure photometry and colour at each ambient-dependent operating state. Pass if every state complies with the applicable lamp regulation (e.g. R7 / R148 for position and stop lamps, R23 / R148 for reversing lamps).

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with the other functions of the module switched ON and OFF in all combinations. Pass if every state complies with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned, including the intensity ratio of stop lamp to position lamp.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and colour for each function provided by the shared light sources, e.g. LEDs serving both the position and stop functions at different intensities. Pass if each function meets its own regulation requirements.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Installation check per paragraph 5.10.4.1 (Annex 4 Zone 1, 25 m in front of the vehicle); pass if no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Visual/geometric check on vehicle: observer moves within Zone 1 of Annex 4 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle; pass if no part of the apparent surface of any red lamp is directly visible.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection on the M1 vehicle: operate the position lamp switch and confirm that the rear position lamps switch ON and OFF together with the front position lamps, the rear registration plate lamp and any end-outline or side-marker lamps. Repeat to confirm none can be switched independently, except under the conditions listed in 5.11.1. Pass: switching is always simultaneous.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp is the following: White.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the reversing lamp through the outer lens window (spectroradiometer/colorimeter, CIE 1931 coordinates) at rated voltage; pass if chromaticity (x,y) lies within the white boundaries W12–W61 defined in the Regulation.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp is the following: Red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the stop lamp through the outer lens at rated voltage; pass if chromaticity (x,y) lies within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp is the following: Red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the rear position lamp through the outer lens at rated voltage; pass if chromaticity (x,y) lies within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, is the following: Red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric check of the retro-reflected light under CIE standard illuminant A illumination per the retro-reflector device regulation; pass if chromaticity lies within the red chromaticity area.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation against the individual specifications of UN R48 (paragraphs 6.x for each function); pass if the number of rear position, stop, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors fitted equals the number indicated (e.g. 2 rear position lamps, 2 stop lamps, 1 or 2 reversing lamps, 2 rear retro-reflectors).

requirements.text: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection of the vehicle drawings and the vehicle: determine whether any lamp function or the retro-reflector is mounted on a movable component. If none is, record the provision as not applicable to this body-mounted unit. If any is, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. Pass if the lamp is body-mounted or if all three referenced conditions are met.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of rear position lamps shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: place each movable component in every fixed position (stable or natural rest positions specified by the manufacturer, locked or not) other than the normal position of use; measure the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis; pass if ≤50 per cent is hidden.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed position other than the normal position of use; measure the apparent surface of the retro-reflector in the direction of the reference axis; pass if ≤50 per cent is hidden.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Where >50 per cent hiding occurs: verify additional lamps meet position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps and are switched ON automatically whenever the movable component hides >50 per cent of the apparent surface; pass if both conditions met.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for retro-reflectors shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these retro-reflectors is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Where >50 per cent hiding of the retro-reflector occurs: verify additional devices meet position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements and are active when the movable component hides >50 per cent; pass if met.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: where the rear position lamp apparent surface can be >50 per cent hidden and no additional lamps are provided, check presence of the user notice in the vehicle with the required content; pass if present.

requirements.text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when the lamp cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the lamp as installed on the vehicle: with the vehicle wiring and connector as delivered, confirm that each of the rear position, stop and reversing functions operates when only a light source and/or fuse is installed. Pass if every function operates without any other modification; otherwise that function is deemed not present.

requirements.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of rear position lamp LEDs; verify replacement function emits red light, with intensity per R7 rear position lamp values and from comparable position (within the same lamp/apparent surface area); pass if colour, main intensity and position are similar.

requirements.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: With rear position lamp failure simulated and replacement active, activate the replacement device's original function (e.g. braking); pass if original function operates with required photometry and is distinguishable.

requirements.text: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure on vehicle; pass if dashboard tell-tale activates indicating temporary replacement and need for repair for the full duration of replacement.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., are allowed, provided that the intensity of all the lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Functional test across the intensity control range: measure the intensity of the R2 and S2 functions at several control steps and confirm they vary together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control are allowed, provided that in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of the stop and rear position lamp intensities during transitions across the full range; the prescribed stop/position intensity ratio (where applicable) is maintained at every point.

requirements.text: Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed in relation to the following conditions: ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds, contamination of the light emitting surface.
requirements.test_case: Review of the control strategy: intensity variation is triggered only by the listed environmental conditions. Photometry at the minimum and maximum settings stays within the R2/S2 limits of the pertinent UN Regulation.

requirements.text: Independent from environmental conditions mentioned under 5.26.1. a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level functional test: the traffic-related intensity decrease is activated only at speed <= 20 km/h or following distance <= 20 m. The reduced intensity stays within the regulation minimum.

requirements.text: As long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level functional test: an already activated decrease is cancelled once vehicle speed exceeds 50 km/h.

requirements.text: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
requirements.test_case: Record luminous intensity versus time during transitions; the variation is gradual, with no step or abrupt change observable.

requirements.text: It may be possible for the driver to set the functions above to static luminous intensities.
requirements.test_case: If a driver override is provided, verify the lamps hold a static intensity within the regulation limits when it is selected.

requirements.text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.test_case: With the vehicle electrical system in a constant voltage operating condition representative of the M1 category as specified by the applicant, measure the voltage at the device terminals. Pass if it does not exceed the voltage stated in the device's type approval documentation.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: With the vehicle electrical system in a constant voltage operating condition representative of the category, measure the terminal voltage. Pass if it is ≤ 6.75 V + 3 % (6.95 V).

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: With the vehicle electrical system in a constant voltage operating condition representative of the category, measure the terminal voltage. Pass if it is ≤ 13.5 V + 3 % (13.905 V).

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: With the vehicle electrical system in a constant voltage operating condition representative of the category, measure the terminal voltage. Pass if it is ≤ 28 V + 3 % (28.84 V).

requirements.text: The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the device may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device.
requirements.test_case: Design review: if voltage limiting is integrated in the lamp housing, check that the terminal voltage limits of paragraph 5.27.2 are still met under constant voltage operating conditions.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection on vehicle: check each function's angles of geometric visibility from infinity (or with parallel-shifted observation direction); pass if no vehicle part obstructs light from any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles already present at lamp type approval.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of the lamp with the hidden portion masked as on the vehicle; pass if values meet the photometric requirements of the device approval regulation.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5º (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height per para. 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, verify photometric field down to 5° below horizontal is met; pass if photometric values satisfied within reduced field.

requirements.text: A LED module does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
requirements.test_case: Document review: if the LED modules are non-replaceable, check that the communication sheet of the component type approval states this. Pass if the statement is present, or if the LED modules are replaceable.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify that valid type approvals exist for each function under the device Regulation referenced in paragraph 6 of UN R48 (e.g. UN R148 for rear position, stop and reversing lamps; UN R150 for the retro-reflector). Verify that the corresponding approval marks are present on the lamp as installed. Pass if every function has a matching approval and marking.

requirements.text: Presence of the reversing lamp: Mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: confirm a reversing lamp function is fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

requirements.text: Number: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count reversing lamp devices fitted (handed pair); pass if 1 or 2 devices.

requirements.text: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify R23 or R148 approval mark/certificate for the reversing lamp function; pass if valid approval exists.

requirements.text: In height: not less than 250 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the lowest edge of the apparent surface above ground on the vehicle in unladen condition; pass if >= 250 mm.

requirements.text: In height: not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the highest edge of the apparent surface above ground on the vehicle in unladen condition; pass if <= 1,200 mm.

requirements.text: In length: at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify reversing lamp installed at the vehicle rear; pass if located at rear.

requirements.text: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check of the apparent surface on vehicle per para 2.10.7; pass if unobstructed over 15° up and 5° down.

requirements.text: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device.
requirements.test_case: With a single reversing lamp fitted, check apparent surface visibility per para 2.10.7; pass if unobstructed over 45° left and right.

requirements.text: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
requirements.test_case: With two reversing lamps fitted, check apparent surface visibility per para 2.10.7; pass if unobstructed over 45° outwards and 30° inwards for each lamp.

requirements.text: Orientation: Rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify reference axis of the reversing lamp is directed rearwards; pass if oriented rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: engage reverse with propulsion system operable; pass if lamp switches ON only under both conditions.

requirements.text: The lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: disengage reverse gear, then separately switch propulsion control to off position; pass if lamp does not switch ON and switches OFF in each case.

requirements.text: Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check R23/R148 failure provisions; if required, simulate LED failure and verify tell-tale indication; pass if failure tell-tale operates when required.

requirements.text: Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

requirements.text: Two S1 or S2 category devices on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count S1/S2 stop lamp devices at the rear; pass if exactly two (one in each left/right unit).

requirements.text: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document check: verify the stop lamp carries a valid approval mark/certificate to UN R7 02 series or later or UN R148 00 series or later; pass if approval present.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on vehicle the distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface (reference axis direction) to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of lowest point of apparent surface above ground with vehicle in unladen condition per para 5.8.1; pass if ≥ 350 mm.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure height of highest point of apparent surface above ground per para 5.8.1; pass if ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork justification applies and no optional lamps fitted).

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the stop lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle; pass if rear-mounted.

requirements.text: Geometric visibility Horizontal angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check of apparent surface on vehicle (CAD or goniometric): pass if unobstructed visibility 45° outward and 45° inward from longitudinal axis.

requirements.text: However, for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height per para 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, verify inward visibility under H plane is at least 20°; pass if condition and angle met.

requirements.text: Vertical angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle: pass if unobstructed visibility 15° above and 15° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height per para 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, verify downward visibility of at least 5°; pass if condition and angle met.

requirements.text: Orientation Towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify reference axis of the stop lamp is directed towards the rear of the vehicle; pass if rearward.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: apply braking signal per UN R13-H; verify all stop lamps illuminate simultaneously; pass if all switch ON together.

requirements.text: The stop lamps need not function if the device, which starts and/or stops the propulsion system, is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: with propulsion start/stop device in a position preventing operation, apply brake; stop lamp may remain OFF; pass if behaviour otherwise complies with 6.7.7.1 when propulsion is operable.

requirements.text: Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check component regulation (UN R7/R148) requirements; if failure tell-tale required, simulate stop lamp failure and verify tell-tale activation; pass if tell-tale operates.

requirements.text: Rear position lamp devices of R or R1 or R2 categories: Mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking on the lamp: category R, R1 or R2 is present.

requirements.text: Number of rear position lamps: Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: exactly two mandatory rear position lamps are fitted, each carrying a UN R7 (02 or later) or UN R148 (00 or later) approval marking.

requirements.text: In width: that point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface (along the reference axis) to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle: pass if ≤ 400 mm on each side.

requirements.text: In height: the rear position lamp shall be above the ground not less than 350 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure per paragraph 5.8.1 on the unladen vehicle: lowest point of the apparent surface ≥ 350 mm above ground.

requirements.text: In height: the rear position lamp shall be above the ground not more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure per paragraph 5.8.1: highest point of the apparent surface ≤ 1,500 mm above ground (≤ 2,100 mm only where justified by bodywork shape).

requirements.text: In length: the rear position lamp shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: lamp is located on the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Geometric visibility of the rear position lamp: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.13 on the vehicle: apparent surface visible over 45° inwards (or 20° under the H plane if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: Geometric visibility of the rear position lamp: Horizontal angle: 80° outwards.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: apparent surface visible up to 80° outwards without obstruction by bodywork.

requirements.text: Where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify the mounting height < 750 mm per 5.8.1 before applying the reduced 20° inward angle below the H plane.

requirements.text: Geometric visibility of the rear position lamp: Vertical angle: 15° above the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: apparent surface visible up to 15° above the horizontal.

requirements.text: Geometric visibility of the rear position lamp: Vertical angle: 15° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: apparent surface visible down to 15° below the horizontal (5° if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: Where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify the mounting height < 750 mm per 5.8.1 before applying the reduced 5° downward angle.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards.
requirements.test_case: If the alternative is chosen, confirm a rear side-marker lamp is fitted; then verify visibility from 45° outwards to 45° inwards.

requirements.text: Under the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify the mounting height < 750 mm per 5.8.1 before applying the reduced 20° inward angle below the H plane.

requirements.text: Under the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check: visible from 15° above to 15° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: Under the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify the mounting height < 750 mm per 5.8.1 before applying the reduced 5° downward angle.

requirements.text: To be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.
requirements.test_case: At each limit angle, measure the unobstructed projected apparent surface: pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: Orientation of the rear position lamp: Rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: reference axis of the lamp is directed rearwards.

requirements.text: Electrical connections of the rear position lamp: In accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on the vehicle: rear position lamps switch ON together with front position lamps, end-outline marker, side-marker and registration plate lamps as required by 5.11.

requirements.text: Tell-tale for the rear position lamp: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle check: a closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates when the rear position lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle check: the same tell-tale indicates both front and rear position lamps ON (not required when daytime running lamps are ON).

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: If UN R7/R148 requires failure indication for the LED lamp, simulate an LED failure and verify the failure tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: Presence of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular: Mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the rear non-triangular retro-reflectors are fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

requirements.text: Number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular: Two.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the mandatory rear retro-reflectors on the vehicle; pass if two (one per handed lamp).

requirements.text: The two rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking and certificate of the retro-reflector; pass if Class IA or IB approval to UN R3 02 series or later, or UN R150 00 series or later.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below), are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection of any additional retro-reflecting devices or materials; pass if they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.

requirements.text: In width: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: In height: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the lowest point of the illuminating surface above the ground with the unladen vehicle per paragraph 5.8; pass if ≥ 250 mm.

requirements.text: In height: Above the ground, not more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the highest point of the illuminating surface above the ground; pass if ≤ 900 mm, or ≤ 1,200 mm when grouped with rear lamp(s) (as in this combination lamp), or ≤ 1,500 mm where bodywork shape prevents compliance.

requirements.text: In length: at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Geometric visibility: Horizontal angle: 30° inwards.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility of the illuminating surface on the vehicle or by drawing; pass if unobstructed through 30° inwards.

requirements.text: Geometric visibility: Horizontal angle: 30° outwards.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility of the illuminating surface; pass if unobstructed through 30° outwards.

requirements.text: Geometric visibility: Vertical angle: 10° above horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility of the illuminating surface; pass if unobstructed through 10° above horizontal.

requirements.text: Geometric visibility: Vertical angle: 10° below horizontal. However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1 and check geometric visibility; pass if unobstructed through 10° below horizontal, or 5° below where mounted below 750 mm.

requirements.text: Orientation: Rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if the reference axis of the retro-reflector is oriented rearwards.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the retro-reflector may have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
requirements.test_case: Design review: permission only; confirm any shared surface is with a lamp situated at the rear.

requirements.text: In their respective planes, the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer are bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Visual check per paragraph 5.10.4 and Annex 4 on the vehicle: observer's eye moved within zone 1 from 1 m to 2.2 m above the ground. Pass: no red light from the rear position or stop lamp directly visible to the front.

requirements.text: In their respective planes, the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer are bounded in width by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width.
requirements.test_case: Geometric and visual check per Annex 4 on the vehicle: define the zone boundaries at 15° outwards through the overall-width contact points. Pass: no red light from the rear position or stop lamp directly visible to the front within zone 1. Any white light to the rear within zone 2 comes only from the reversing lamp, as permitted by paragraph 5.10.

requirements.text: If there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
requirements.test_case: Review of the vehicle overall-width contact points. Pass: the forward zone plane passes through the foremost contact point and the rearward zone plane passes through the rearmost contact point.

requirements.text: The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured width, height and length distances with the individual installation specifications for each lamp function; pass if all are within the limits.

requirements.text: The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured geometric visibility angles with the individual specifications for each lamp; pass if fulfilled, with an allowance of ±3º on the angle limits.

requirements.text: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lamp controls (lights switch, brake, reverse gear); pass if switching behaviour meets paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. and the individual specifications for each lamp.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare the inspection results with paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. and the individual specifications for each lamp; pass if all requirements are met.
